warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0143 staging draft; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target uses “I want to buy it.” and “How much is it?” are short, natural English for the scenario; dialogue turns were checked for agreement, tense, articles and punctuation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: buy is consistently represented as «خریدن» in the selected sense, and Persian prompts preserve the English task meaning without adding unsupported context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A01 introduces the lexical meaning, A02 exposes the full dialogue, and all dialogue-dependent listening/reconstruction/retrieval occurs only afterward in A03, A06, A07 and A10.

distractorQuality.evidence: Choice distractors are grammatical, natural alternatives that change meaning or information rather than relying on malformed English.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Canonical arc EN-A1-CLASSMATES uses its declared cast (الکس، مایا) and respects Course return spacing.

difficultyFit.evidence: One new A1 lexical target (buy) plus one bounded grammar construction and one due review item keeps the load controlled.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The Lesson combines its current target with explicit spaced retrieval of previously taught language; no real learner test is claimed.

transferQuality.evidence: The lesson moves from “I want to buy it.” to “How much is it?”, changing the information while preserving the target sense or construction.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target construction, dialogue and activities all support the stated outcome for buy and grammar key CEFRJ-GRAM-247.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed. Model/editor review checks runtime order, answer exposure, clarity and cognitive load only.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image, photo or visual claim exists. Every listening/replay activity references T01–T04 turns marked audioRequired and first exposed through A02; no listening task points to an unreferenced media object.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
